about: Pack supply (v0.8.9, api/pack_supply.py, docs/shop.md "Sold out"): the sets whose print run a source states, in cards. Every product of a set takes its cards out of the set's run, as the real starter decks and boosters came off the same presses: a pack's cards are its real size (cards_per_product), counted for every pack bought or given to an account other than SysOp. When what is left cannot fill one more of a product, it is sold out: the shop shows SOLD OUT across it and sells and gives no more. A set whose run no source states (Revised and every set after Fallen Empires) is not limited. Read 2026-11-06.

sources.dangelo-1995: Stephen D'Angelo, 'Rulings Summary: Cards', updated 1995-07-05, posted to rec.games.trading-cards.magic.rules 1995-07-06 (https://groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.magic.rules/c/TASsCMbhyjw): the Magic rules summary of the time, giving 'Approximately N cards were printed' for each early set.
sources.duelist-card-list: The Duelist Presents the Complete Magic Card List (Wizards of the Coast, 1996, https://archive.org/details/TheDuelistPresentstheCompleteMagicCardList): Limited Edition 'a 10-million-card print run', 2.6 million Alpha and 7.3 million Beta.
sources.print-runs: content/print-runs.json: the copies of each Alpha and Beta sheet printed (Scrye's table), which come to 2,601,500 Alpha and 7,792,400 Beta cards.

sets.name: Limited Edition Alpha
sets.note: 'Approximately 2.6 million cards were printed.' The Duelist's card list gives the same 2.6 million; the sheet counts in print-runs.json come to 2,601,500.

sets.name: Limited Edition Beta
sets.note: 'Approximately 7.8 million cards were printed.' The sheet counts in print-runs.json come to 7,792,400, which agree; The Duelist's card list gives 7.3 million, so this may be up to 7% high.

sets.name: Unlimited Edition
sets.note: 'Approximately 40 million cards were printed.' Some later articles give 35 million.

sets.name: Arabian Nights
sets.note: 'Approximately 5 million cards were printed.' Sold in boosters of 8 only.

sets.name: Antiquities
sets.note: 'Approximately 15 million cards were printed.' Sold in boosters of 8 only.

sets.name: Legends
sets.note: 'Approximately 35 million cards were printed.' Sold in boosters of 15 only.

sets.name: The Dark
sets.note: 'Approximately 75 million cards were printed.' Some later articles give 62 million. Sold in boosters of 8 only.

sets.name: Fallen Empires
sets.note: 'The printing size is estimated to be between 350 and 375 million cards': the lower figure is used. Sold in boosters of 8 only.
